name: Thaumaturgy (Weather Control) — Basic — Rain or Snow

system.description: You spend a Willpower Trait and Mental Traits to call down rain or snow (depending on ambient temperature), seriously impairing visibility-those attempting to spot things by normal sight must bid four extra Traits, or two extra Traits with Auspex. Surfaces grow wet or slippery, and driving becomes hazardous, with the faster the change, the more Mental Traits required. This power generally does not function well indoors.
system.duration: Minutes to a day depending on Traits spent
